test_coverage_notes: The code is likely covered by integration and unit tests in the XRPLF/rippled repository, especially in test files under src/test/app/ledger, src/test/rpc, and src/test/ledger. Tests would exercise ledger serialization via RPC calls (ledger, ledger_data, tx, etc.), covering different fill.options, apiVersion, and ledger states. However, pointer null checks (stMeta, txn) may not be explicitly tested for null pointer dereference, and edge cases for malformed or missing fields may not be fully covered. There is no evidence of explicit negative tests for all validation branches (e.g., apiVersion boundary, empty closeTime, null stMeta).
